result.query:
SELECT TOP 1000 [MBusinessKey] AS [MBusinessKey], [HrefIndicatorDashboard] AS [HrefIndicatorDashboard], [DataGenerationDate] AS [DataGenerationDate], [MTypeName] AS [MTypeName], [MName] AS [MName], [Unit] AS [Unit], [AreaName] AS [AreaName], [LinkIndicatorDescription] AS [LinkIndicatorDescription], [LinkIndicatorDescriptionTitle] AS [LinkIndicatorDescriptionTitle], [DataSource] AS [DataSource], [Description] AS [Description], [DesiredValue] AS [DesiredValue], [InputType] AS [InputType], [Keywords] AS [Keywords], [MeasurePeriodInterval] AS [MeasurePeriodInterval] 
FROM (SELECT 
	  MBusinessKey
	  ,MTypeBusinessKey
	  ,MName
      ,MTypeName
      ,InputType
      ,AreaName
	  ,[semantic].[HrefIndicatorDashboard](
                                          'dataanalys.socialstyrelsen.se',
                                          URLslugDashboardTitle, 
                                          Unit, 
                                          UrlslugDashboard
    ) as HrefIndicatorDashboard 
    ,[semantic].[LinkAreaDashboard]('dataanalys.socialstyrelsen.se', URLslugStartpageDashboard) as LinkStartPageDashboard
    ,LinkStartPageDashboardTitle
    ,Unit
	  ,LinkIndicatorDescription
	  ,LinkIndicatorDescriptionTitle
	  ,LinkAreaDescription
	  ,LinkAreaDescriptionTitle
	  ,mattenhet_kort
    ,Description
    ,DesiredValue
    ,DataSource
    ,[Keywords]
      ,[Aim]
      ,[NumeratorDefinition]
      ,[DenominatorDefinition]
	  ,[MeasurementPeriodType]
    ,[FirstYear]
    ,[LastYear]
	  ,MeasurePeriodInterval
    ,LastValue
    ,FirstValue
    ,UnitChangeFirstValue
    ,UnitChangePreviousValue
    ,GrowthFirstValue
    ,GrowthPreviousValue
    ,[DataGenerationDate]
  FROM [semantic].[VAI_NRAA_GroupStats_LastObs]
) AS virtual_table GROUP BY [MBusinessKey], [HrefIndicatorDashboard], [DataGenerationDate], [MTypeName], [MName], [Unit], [AreaName], [LinkIndicatorDescription], [LinkIndicatorDescriptionTitle], [DataSource], [Description], [DesiredValue], [InputType], [Keywords], [MeasurePeriodInterval];
